units.source_text: 我既像店裡的顧客，又像店裡的老闆；

en.t: I was like a customer of the shop, and also like its owner;

units.source_text: 既像跑腿的店員，又像老闆娘的親戚。

en.t: I was like an errand-running clerk, and also like a relative of the proprietress.

units.source_text: 在旁人眼中，我也許是一個來歷不明的存在，

en.t: To others, I may have seemed like a person of unknown origin,

units.source_text: 但世人一點都不覺得我奇怪，

en.t: but the world did not find me strange at all,

units.source_text: 店裡的常客們也「小葉、小葉」地叫我，

en.t: and the regulars at the shop would call me, "Yo-chan, Yo-chan,"

units.source_text: 對我非常友好，還請我喝酒。

en.t: treating me very kindly and even buying me drinks.

units.source_text: 慢慢地，我不再小心翼翼地提防世人了，

en.t: Little by little, I stopped warily guarding myself against the world,

units.source_text: 開始覺得世人並非那麼可怕。

en.t: and began to feel that people were not so frightening after all.
